en: A sepia-toned photograph shows a large historic building complex on a high stone terrace or fortification wall, likely part of a castle or palace. Below the wall is a park-like green area with trees and a small decorative wooden bridge over a path or stream. In the foreground, two figures—an adult and a child—walk along the path. Tree branches frame the top of the image, and the sky is filled with dramatic clouds. The style and printing suggest an early-20th-century picture postcard.
